message: FlowOS.Api Dockerfile CSPROJ COPY missing FlowOS.Notifications.csproj (ref by FlowOS.Infrastructure.csproj). dotnet restore SKIPPED it.
FlowOS.MCP Dockerfile CSPROJ COPY MISSING FlowOS.Application.csproj (DIRECT ref of FlowOS.MCP + FlowOS.Infrastructure). dotnet restore SKIPPED it 3 times.

FlowOS.MCP.csproj targets net9.0 (OutputType=Exe) but ALL 6 direct dependencies target net8.0 (Domain/Infra/Workflows/StateMachines/Core/Application). MCP Dockerfile uses sdk:9.0/aspnet:9.0 while Api uses sdk:8.0/aspnet:8.0. Potential missing targeting-pack + assembly load failure.

Local SDK 9.0.200 built both projects fine. SDK 9 includes net8 targeting packs. But runtime aspnet:9.0 image does NOT include Microsoft.AspNetCore.App v8.0 shared framework - FlowOS.Notifications.dll has FrameworkReference Microsoft.AspNetCore.App net8.0, will fail at container startup.

docker-compose.test.yaml declares traefik-network as external:true. Fresh deploy server that never ran docker network create traefik-network will get compose EXIT non-zero. Deploy script runs set -e so whole Actions run fails.

deploy.yaml SSH block runs git reset --hard origin/main ; git pull. Redundant; reset hard to origin/main leaves HEAD exactly at remote; pull then tries fast-forward; on diverged refs can exit non-zero. Safer: skip pull, or checkout origin/main directly.
.gitattributes pushed; EndToEndTests csproj BOM fixed. Hypothesis 4 currently not supported as primary cause but preventive fix already in place.

ROOT CAUSES IDENTIFIED (ranked): 1) traefik-network external:true + no network create in deploy  compose up exit non-zero. 2) FlowOS.MCP targets net9.0/aspnet:9.0 but FlowOS.Notifications.dll (transitive ref) has FrameworkReference Microsoft.AspNetCore.App/net8.0; aspnet:9.0 final image has NO net8 shared framework  container crashes, compose up fails. 3) Dockerfile CSPROJ COPY lists incomplete (Notifications missing in Api, Application missing in MCP)  layer cache inefficiency and potential future break. 4) Deploy git reset+pull redundancy: transient risk of non-zero. Fix all 4 now.
